summary: Track your reef tank's critical parameters and never lose a coral to preventable parameter swings.
features: Designed for reef chemistry — the Ca/Alk/Mg triad is front and center
Instant health indicator — green/yellow/red based on your actual values vs. safe ranges
Multiple tanks — manage a display tank, frag tank, and sump separately
Water change log — never forget when you last changed water
Coral inventory — track what you have, what it cost, and how it's doing
100% offline — no account, no subscription, no cloud required
